title: Every page says it is satire, to people and to agents
description:
Papyrus makes every page easy for agents to read. Without a marker, satire is read as fact.

```gherkin
Feature: Satire marker

  Scenario: A reader sees the label
    Given a published piece on a satire site
    When a reader opens it
    Then the page shows that it is satire

  Scenario: An agent reads the label
    Given the same piece
    When an agent fetches the Markdown version, the feed, the structured data or llms.txt
    Then each one states that the piece is satire

  Scenario: A shared link carries the label
    Given the same piece
    When its link is shared
    Then the preview text or image states that it is satire

  Scenario: A news site has no label
    Given a site that is not marked as satire
    When its pages are built
    Then no satire label appears
```
